name: Kandariya Mahadeva Temple
_about: Kandariya Mahadeva: all of it the buff sandstone of Panna, coursed -- the terrace, the plinths, the walls, the roofs and the tower alike, one stone from the ground to the kalasha; the floors flagged in it, the cell inside dark.

rules._about: the jangha: its registers of carved figures, the temple's glory
the tower under its net of horseshoe dormers
the roofs and the tower in finer courses
